notes.title: Fixes & Small Graphical Improvements | Update 1 Patch 1
notes.content: Howdy, I've made some slight changes to vegetation graphics and fixed a couple of bugs. Hope you're enjoying the game!

notes.title: Fixes & Graphical Improvments | Update 1
notes.content:
Howdy, I've made some graphical improvements to the Arizona Ranch and Home maps. I've also fixed animals running into the outer wall forever and added a indicator for iron sighted gun controls.

I've specifically updated the models for grass and trees, hopefully this makes the game looks better. Let me know what you think in the comments bellow this post.

notes.title: Improvements To Iron Sights | Patch
notes.content:
Howdy, I've just released a patch that should make the iron sights re-center while you aim. Basically this makes it way more viable to actually use them. They don't quite re-center to the middle so you'll still need to use middle mouse to adjust your aim.

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed iron sights to be better
[/list]

notes.title: The Great Tutorializing | Update
notes.content:
Howdy, a lot of folks were confused about the game's mechanics so I've added not one but 2 more tutorials to the game to help with that! A video tutorial and a long text based one. They're accessible using tab. I've also added more feedback for what buttons to press and why the gun isn't shooting.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a long text tutorial
[*] Added a video tutorial on YouTube
[*] Added warning for why you can't shoot
[*] Added controls to scope view
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed Tutorial | Small Update
notes.content: Howdy, I just fixed the tutorial which was pretty confusing before. Let me know if you get stuck anywhere else.

notes.title: Demo Release! Stay tuned for more!
notes.content:
Howdy, the demo has finally been released! I hope you'll enjoy the demo and make sure to wishlist it. The demo will be updated, so be sure to check back for updates.

Please let your favorite streamers and youtubers know about the game, that would really help me out.
